description: How every Hatchet SDK treats a unary gRPC call that the engine throttles. The Go, Python, TypeScript and Ruby SDK tests all run these scenarios, so the SDKs cannot drift apart. In each scenario the call fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and a google.rpc.RetryInfo delay of delays_ms[i] on attempt i, and succeeds on the next attempt if the SDK makes one. waits_ms are the waits the SDK must make between attempts, in order; it makes one more request than it waits. succeeds says whether the call returns a result or the last error.

scenarios.name: one throttle waits the server's delay
a second throttle waits its own delay doubled
the wait doubles with each retry up to 5 seconds
a call throttled on every attempt fails after 5 attempts
a delay of exactly 5 seconds is waited
a delay over 5 seconds fails the call at once
a later delay over 5 seconds ends the call
